entries.what: Walks to Flats High on Vinca for the first day of semester midterms; geometry exam first period, then eats lunch in room B12 with Karina and Eli.
entries.outcome: Geometry felt easy; numbers were fine.

entries.what: Chemistry midterm in Ms. Tolentino's third period, sitting next to Karina as lab partner.
entries.outcome: Finished the calculation section fast, rushed the written questions.

entries.what: Studies at the library homework center after school for the next day's English exam, then walks home to unit 114.
entries.outcome: Made flashcards and got home before her mom's usual dinner.

entries.what: Takes the English 10 midterm second period and world history review in fourth.
entries.outcome: Wrote the essay section in time, barely.

entries.what: Tuesday study session at the library homework center 3:30-5 with Karina, going over chem notes.
entries.outcome: Karina quizzed her on stoichiometry until they could both do it.

entries.what: Eats dinner with Yesenia at home and goes to bed around 11:30 after texting in the lab rats chat.
entries.outcome: Short chat jokes before sleep.

entries.what: Midterms in world history and Spanish for heritage speakers; Spanish oral exam went easily.
entries.outcome: Felt confident in Spanish.

entries.what: Skips boba after school with the new crew and goes straight home to rest.
entries.outcome: Kept to her one-drink-a-week cap.

entries.what: Helps Yesenia with groceries at Ruiz Family Market in the evening.
entries.outcome: Picked up fixings for dinner.

entries.what: PE fitness testing and last midterm review at school; lunch in B12.
entries.outcome: Got through the mile run slowly but finished.

entries.what: Thursday library homework center session 3:30-5 to finish chem lab writeups.
entries.outcome: Turned in the final lab conclusion draft.

entries.what: Folds to-go boxes at the family pupusa stand at the Ruel Road gas station lot Thursday evening.
entries.outcome: Tía Gladys did not have to redo the boxes.

entries.what: Last day of midterms; chemistry lab practical review with Ms. Tolentino's class, then lunch in B12.
entries.outcome: Midterms all done.

entries.what: Works her Friday 4-9 p.m. shift taking orders at Taquería Colima and counts the drawer at close.
entries.outcome: Drawer matched to the penny.

entries.what: Rafael picks her up after close and drives her home.
entries.outcome: Home by about 9:30 with a free quesadilla in her bag.

entries.what: Bags groceries at the Thanksgiving food drive at Our Lady of the Marsh, 8-11 a.m., next to Karina.
entries.outcome: Handed out turkeys and bags to dozens of families.

entries.what: Does Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room, then works her Saturday 11-3 shift at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Busy fall rush lunch; clothes folded by evening.

entries.what: Evening at home watching videos and editing a clip she won't post.
entries.outcome: Early night.

entries.what: Works Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Steady Sunday crowd, no mistakes on tickets.

entries.what: Takes the 22 bus home down Calle Ortega and eats dinner with Yesenia.
entries.outcome: Told her mom about the food drive.

entries.what: Late text from Karina asking if people are talking about her; Dulce reassures her.
entries.outcome: Both settled and went to sleep.

new_facts.value: bagged groceries beside Karina at the Nov 22 food drive

new_facts.value: ran the PE fitness mile in just over 11 minutes

new_facts.subject: dulce
new_facts.value: wants to buy a winter jacket with her next paychecks
